sample_axis: paired held-out sequences/windows; globally centered once

metadata.last_layer: interaction.global_proj output; actual TPP.forward state before intensity head
metadata.sample_unit: one causal context for a valid next-event prediction
metadata.sample_selection: seeded uniform sampling without replacement across all test contexts
metadata.pooling: first: observed entries in each causal window; last: native global context vector
metadata.architecture_note: TPP uses its own ITSPM implementation with one mixer block and no kernel branch.
metadata.training_note: Original taxi.sh architecture, likelihood, Adam and epoch count; only validation loglike is evaluated during training. Stochastic thinning prediction is omitted, so RNG trajectory differs from the benchmark runner.
metadata.dependence_note: Multiple contexts may come from the same test sequence; CKA is descriptive, with no independence-based confidence interval.
metadata.checkpoint_note: Training weights are regenerated by the documented commands; paired representations are included for CKA verification.
